sql_schemas: table employees | fields: id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, email, manager_id, department, hire_date, termination_date, employment_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employees.id | indexes: employee_number: unique lookup by employee number; email: unique lookup by email; manager_id: team hierarchy queries — list direct reports; employment_status: filter active/inactive/terminated employees; deleted_at: soft-delete filtering

table leave_policies | fields: id, policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: leave_type: filter policies by leave type (annual, sick, emergency); is_active: filter only active policies for balance calculations and request validation

table leave_requests | fields: id, employee_id, leave_policy_id, start_date, end_date, reason, status, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; leave_policy_id -> leave_policies.id; approved_by -> employees.id | indexes: employee_id: list all leave requests for an employee; status: filter by status — pending approvals queue; approved_by: manager approval queue lookup; start_date: calendar-range queries and conflict detection; end_date: calendar-range queries and conflict detection; (employee_id, status): compound filter for employee-specific status views

table leave_balances | fields: id, employee_id, leave_policy_id, total_entitlement, used_days, remaining_days, fiscal_year, status, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; leave_policy_id -> leave_policies.id | indexes: employee_id: look up balances for an employee; leave_policy_id: filter balances by policy; fiscal_year: filter balances by fiscal year; (employee_id, leave_policy_id, fiscal_year): unique compound lookup — one balance row per employee per policy per year

table audit_logs | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, old_values, new_values, performed_by, performed_at, ip_address, user_agent, created_at | pk: id | indexes: (entity_type, entity_id): look up audit trail for a specific entity; performed_by: look up actions by a specific user; performed_at: time-range queries for audit reports; action: filter by action type (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT)
